caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate coffee pot positioned in the center of the composition, rendered primarily in graphite with subtle shading to indicate its metallic, reflective surface. The coffee pot features a rounded, bulbous lower body that narrows slightly before flaring out again at the base, which is decorated with a pattern of vertical lines. The spout is elaborately curved and ornamented with scroll-like designs, extending to the left. The lid of the coffee pot rises to a domed top and is crowned with a decorative finial. The handle, attached to the right side, is colored in a light brown tone, distinct from the rest of the pot, and has a curved, wooden appearance with a thicker upper section that tapers towards the lower attachment point. The background is plain and unadorned, with the focus entirely on the coffee pot. The artist's signature, "David P. Willoughby," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Teapot
